notes.title: Update notes 0.6.3.5
notes.notes:
Features:


     Inventory Management: You can now drop items from your inventory by dragging them outside of the UI.
     Commission Recipes: NPC commission recipes are now displayed in your player crafting tab.
     Auto-Save on Exit: Quitting to the menu or desktop now saves your game automatically.


Visual Updates:


     Raudlynghi Entrance Rebuild: The entrance to Raudlynghi has been rebuilt—no more loading screen.
     Fjellheim Stair Fix: Resolved the issue with hanging stairs in Fjellheim.
     Water Reflections: Fixed several water reflection issues for improved visuals.


Bug Fixes:


     Crafting Counter: The crafting ingredient counter now updates correctly during crafting.
     Dialogue Overflow: Split overflowing dialogues into two separate dialogues.
     General Updates: Numerous items, dialogues, and quest bugs have been updated.
     Dialogue Bug: Fixed an issue where dialogue wouldn’t work after quitting to the main menu without saving and then starting a new game.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
New Content:
Introduced amulets to expand your gear options.

Gameplay
Added loot to the Fossegrim.

Audio Enhancements:
Fixed an issue where some combat sounds were not playing. Combat audio should now feel more immersive and responsive.

Visual Improvements:
Resolved several visual glitches.

notes.title: Multiplayer Restored & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Multiplayer is back! We’ve also fixed various quest and item bugs, improving stability and gameplay.

Notable fixes:
"The Missing Ledger" was a little too missing. We’ve made it actually findable now.
Dungeon gatherables no longer magically respawn every time you re-enter. No more infinite gold farming.
Arrows no longer vanish from your quiver when loading a game

notes.title: Hotfix - Launch Crash Fix & Temporary Multiplayer Disable
notes.notes:
We've identified and addressed a critical issue causing the game to crash on launch. As a temporary workaround, we have disabled multiplayer while we work on a permanent fix.

We know this isn’t ideal, and we appreciate your patience as we resolve the issue. If you experience any further crashes, please let us know via our support channel on Discord

Thank you for your understanding, and we'll update you as soon as multiplayer is restored!

notes.title: November update
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!


It’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been hard at work updating the closed beta of Eydigard.

Alongside the changes in this patch, we have released a brand-new trailer that offers a sneak peek at some of the powerful new bosses waiting to challenge you.


[previewyoutube=QrX87ro-QAw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] 












We’re also stepping up our presence on YouTube and social media, where we’ll be posting more videos about the lore, characters, and gameplay of Eydigard. Keep an eye out for deeper dives into the world and stories we’re crafting. There’s so much we want to share, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts!

This update includes countless improvements, bug fixes, and adjustments based on your feedback. While we can’t list everything here, we want to highlight three of the major changes to this update:

Added a Prologue
The prologue sets the stage for your journey, introducing you to key mechanics and the setting of Eydigard.

 Added a Day-Night Cycle
The world of Eydigard now follows a natural rhythm of day and night. The sun casts warm light across the fjord during the day, while the moon provides a quieter glow at night. On clear nights, you may even see the northern lights shimmering above.

Visual Overhaul
From the lush pine forests to the haunting abandoned farms, every part of Eydigard has been updated with new visuals. Enjoy enhanced lighting, textures, and environmental effects


This update is a step forward in shaping Eydigard into the game we want it to be. While this patch focuses primarily on visuals, like the new day-night cycle and updated graphics, our goal has always been to enhance both the story and gameplay. We believe these changes lay the groundwork for experiences we think you’ll truly enjoy.

We’ve been brewing a lot of exciting content on our alpha branch—new quests, mechanics, and storylines that we can’t wait to share with you in future updates. Thank you for your support as we work to bring Eydigard to life.

As always, we’re eager to hear your thoughts, and we look forward to showing you more of what’s to come.


Happy adventuring,
The Frostisen Studio Team

notes.title: Update notes 04 August
notes.notes:
Highlights

New Features:
- Preview resulting character in the character creation menu
- Option to choose only mustache for male avatars
- Added sound effects for drawing, reloading, and firing ranged weapons

Bug Fixes and Adjustments:
- Fixed inconsistent dialogue, journal texts, and rewards for various quests
- Closing inventory now clears item icon from cursor
- Fixed issue where effects weren't removed upon death from damage-over-time (DoT)
- Resolved missing recipes and equipment when loading saved games
- Corrected Bear Overpower ability bug


- Implemented numerous minor visual and gameplay improvements
